title: reviews.moderation_content
description: A review's content, for an external moderation module's screening and moderator card. Identifiers travel on the bus, content is fetched by this call at the moment it is looked at, so a case opened hours ago still shows the review as it is now. A moderation policy names this function as its `content_function` for the review target type. Response: {"text", "title", "language", "media", "author_id", "url", "rating", "status", "target_type", "target_key", "created_at"} — a review has no title, declared language, media or public per-review URL, so those four come back empty rather than invented. Unguarded by design: who may read a case's content is the moderation module's `can_view_content` policy to answer.

review_id.description: The review's id — the moderation case's `target_key` for a review target.
